A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the WT is able to provide a short-term active power support for a hydro dominated power system, and the support is more effective for a hydro dominated grid with a high proportion of hydro power generation.
a commercial VSWT has a good potential for temporary primary frequency support and that this potential can be utilized in a hydro dominated power system to reduce the TMF.
the WT under study has the capability of providing an extra active power support of 0.1–0.2 pu for 5–10 s, depending on its parameters.
The main takeaway from our work is that
VSWTs have a great potential in improving the TMF and that the potential can be utilized in a wide range of WT parameters.
the VSWT can be a potential candidate for providing a temporary primary frequency control support.
